narrative: Material PL1__ME16AB86 exhibits lumpy demand (CV=1.39, 48.6% non-zero days) with a statistically significant upward trend (slope=0.563, p=0.007). Lead time is moderately variable (CV=0.37, mean=2.77 days). The EOQ-derived order quantity of 841 units dominates the MOQ of 220 and fits comfortably within the 1,891-unit storage cap. Safety stock is increased 6.3x from the SAP baseline of 69 to 433 units to achieve the 95% service level target, at an incremental holding cost of ~$1,395/year.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Lumpy zero-inflated demand requires continuous monitoring rather than periodic review; a fixed order quantity (EOQ=841) keeps ordering costs predictable while the reorder point (722 units) absorbs demand-during-lead-time uncertainty.
research_insights.boundary_risk: No capacity or MOQ constraint binds. Post-replenishment maximum inventory of 1,274 units is 67.4% of the 1,891-unit storage limit, leaving 617 units of headroom.
